If a group has no data (empty after filtering), should the function skip it (no scatter points) or raise an error?
Is the 'date' column guaranteed to be datetime objects, or should the function handle other date-like formats (strings, pandas Timestamps) and convert them to ordinal?
Should the x-axis (date ordinal) be scaled consistently across all groups (shared axis) or could each group have its own scaling (unique axes) as hinted by 'unique or shared axes'?
Are the groups plotted in the order they appear in the 'groups' list, or in the order they appear in the DataFrame, or sorted?
Should the function add a legend to distinguish groups, or is the color cycle sufficient without a legend?
Is the color cycle fixed as 'bgrcmk' (blue, green, red, cyan, magenta, black) as in the reference, or should it be customizable or follow matplotlib defaults?
